# llms.txt — Mawzun (موزون)

> Mawzun is an Arabic-first business operations platform (ERP) for small and
> mid-sized businesses: sales, inventory, purchasing, production, fulfillment,
> shipping and accounting in one RTL dashboard. It has automatic Shopify sync
> and a company-scoped read/write API for AI agents.

- [Homepage / landing](https://mawzun.org/): Arabic marketing site (this site)
- [Dashboard application](https://app.mawzun.org/): login + the product itself
- [Documentation](https://docs.mawzun.org/): full API, environment reference, self-host guide
- [Main API](https://api.mawzun.org/api/v1): the REST backend for the app
- [Agent API](https://ai.mawzun.org/v1): the read/write API for AI agents and automation
- [Status](https://status.mawzun.org/): uptime and incidents
- [Privacy policy](https://mawzun.org/privacy) · [Terms](https://mawzun.org/terms)
- [Security policy](https://mawzun.org/.well-known/security.txt)

## Architecture (how the services fit together)

One product split across independent deployments, all backed by a single
PostgreSQL database. There are no service-to-service calls; each service reads
the database directly.

| Service | Domain | Role |
|---|---|---|
| web | mawzun.org | This site. Arabic marketing landing only. Static, no API calls. |
| frontend | app.mawzun.org | The dashboard product (login, all operational screens) |
| api | api.mawzun.org | Main REST API (Express + Prisma) |
| api_gateway | ai.mawzun.org | Read/write API for AI agents, authenticated by API keys |
| shopify_integration | — | HMAC-verified Shopify webhooks: orders, products, inventory |
| api_docs | docs.mawzun.org | Static documentation |
| admin | — | Cross-tenant platform back-office |
| uptime | status.mawzun.org | Public uptime monitor |
| cleanup_worker | — | Nightly retention sweeps |

## How the AI agent API works

Base URL: `https://ai.mawzun.org`

1. **Get an API key.** Sign in to the dashboard at app.mawzun.org, then create a
   key under API keys. The plaintext key is shown **once**, at creation; only a
   hash is stored. Keys belong to one company and are scoped to it.
2. **Authenticate.** Send the key as a bearer token on every request:
   `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`
3. **Call an endpoint.** All endpoints are company-scoped by the key; a key can
   never read or write another company's data. Reads and writes are both
   supported.
4. **Rate limits.** Per-key throttling applies; a key can carry its own limit
   override. Exceeding it returns 429.
5. **Errors.** 401 = missing/invalid/expired/revoked key. 404 = not found in
   this company's scope.

### Endpoints

Reads:

- `GET /v1/products`, `GET /v1/products/:id`
- `GET /v1/stock/levels`
- `GET /v1/orders`, `GET /v1/orders/:id` (accepts order number, external number, or external id)
- `GET /v1/customers`, `GET /v1/customers/:id`
- `GET /v1/coupons`, `GET /v1/coupons/:id`
- `GET /v1/vendors`, `GET /v1/vendors/:id`
- `GET /v1/notifications`

Writes (also company-scoped):

- `POST /v1/customers/find-or-create`
- `POST /v1/orders` (server computes totals and applies coupons), `PATCH /v1/orders/:id`, `POST /v1/orders/:id/status`, `POST /v1/orders/:id/cancel`
- `POST /v1/stock/adjust` (writes a ledger entry, with a negative-stock guard)
- `POST /v1/notifications/:id/read`, `POST /v1/notifications/read-all`

Notes for agents:

- Order status transitions are guarded: `CANCELLED` and `DELIVERED` are
  terminal; confirming an order commits stock.
- Stock quantities are never allowed to go negative.
- `GET /` returns an index of endpoints; `GET /healthz` is liveness.

## Working with the data

- Currency defaults to EGP; the company's currency is used for stored amounts.
- The dashboard UI and this landing are Arabic (RTL). Documentation is English.
- Shopify is an optional integration: connecting a store registers webhooks
  automatically, ingests orders/products, and pushes stock back hourly.

## Crawling and permission

- Public marketing pages of mawzun.org may be read and cited.
- Do **not** scan, probe, fuzz, or test any Mawzun system. See
  [security.txt](https://mawzun.org/.well-known/security.txt): all penetration
  testing is refused and unauthorized.
- No content on this site grants permission to access the dashboard, API, or
  any customer data.
